subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

“The Boarded Window” is a horror story about a man who has to ______ with his wife’s death.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**deal**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Deal**" means to cope with or manage a difficult situation or problem. (किसी कठिन परिस्थिति या समस्या से निपटना या उसका प्रबंधन करना)
 
• In the given context, the man has to deal with his wife's death, which is a difficult situation.
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so using "dealt" or "will deal" would be grammatically incorrect.
 
• Other possible synonyms for "deal" in this context could be "handle", "face", or "confront".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Complete sentence**: *“The Boarded Window” is a horror story about a man who has to deal __with his wife’s death. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Dwell**" means to live in a particular place or to think or talk at length about something. (किसी विशेष स्थान पर रहना या किसी चीज़ के बारे में विस्तार से सोचना या बात करना)
 
• "**Drill**" means to make a hole in something using a drill or to train someone or something intensively. (किसी ड्रिल का उपयोग करके किसी चीज़ में छेद करना या किसी को या किसी चीज़ को गहनता से प्रशिक्षित करना)
 
• "**Deed**" means an action or accomplishment, or a legal document that transfers property. (कोई कार्रवाई या उपलब्धि, या कोई कानूनी दस्तावेज़ जो संपत्ति हस्तांतरित करता है)
